name: tracker-mac-snapshot-union
goal: Prove complete Mac snapshot and pending-operation preservation on private offline copies, including replay, conflict evidence and repeatable box delta.

evidence: Two receipt-bound immutable Mac online backups are the only inputs. Verify each row and operation identity, preserve source-local namespaces, and rehearse queued delivery on the pinned native revision with no production listeners.

Private checksummed bundle preserves each Mac source image and a verified runtime union. Legacy Store and RunLog carry materialized journal and node-scoped run projection while keeping source-local namespaces.

Signed replay and lost-receipt retry match the legacy union. All 28 focused Tracker tests passed. A synthetic box delta imported twice produced identical candidate bytes. Malformed input and divergent payloads were rejected.
